title: Localized ring colimit comparison
statement: Let Λ be a nonempty directed preorder, F and L diagrams of commutative rings, and κ a colimit cocone from F to T. Let p be a prime of T, p_i prime ideals of F_i equal to the contractions of p. Suppose specified ring equivalences e_i identify L_i with (F_i)_{p_i}, and the transitions under those equivalences agree on numerator-one elements with the transitions of F. Then there is a ring equivalence e: colim L ≃ T_p whose value on every coprojection of z is the canonical local map induced by κ_i applied to e_i(z). Colimits and localization are [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].

source.place: Tag 02JO (1), first paragraph: localized system and its limit; Tag 037D, proof first paragraph

proof.text: Compose each specified stage equivalence with the canonical local ring map. Localization ring-hom extensionality and the numerator transition identity show these maps form a cocone c to T_p.

For any cocone s on L, restrict along the numerator maps and use the supplied colimit of F to obtain f_s:T→s.pt. Every denominator y outside p has a representative x at a stage, because forget CommRingCat preserves filtered colimits. The contraction identity implies x avoids p_i, so its localized image is a unit and f_s(y) is a unit.

Extend f_s uniquely across T_p by IsLocalization.lift. Factorization at each stage and uniqueness follow by localization ring-hom extensionality and the supplied colimit hom_ext. This proves c is a colimit. The unique isomorphism from the canonical colimit of L to c.pt gives the requested ring equivalence and coprojection formula.

lean.statement:
theorem localizedRingColimitComparison
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (F L : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (κ : F ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of T))
    (hF : Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of T) κ)))
    (p : Ideal T) [p.IsPrime] (pᵢ : ∀ i, Ideal (F.obj i)) [∀ i, (pᵢ i).IsPrime]
    (hp : ∀ i, pᵢ i = p.comap (κ.app i).hom)
    (eᵢ : ∀ i, L.obj i ≃+* Localization.AtPrime (pᵢ i))
    (hm : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (x : F.obj i),
      eᵢ j ((L.map f).hom ((eᵢ i).symm (algebraMap _ _ x))) =
        algebraMap _ _ ((F.map f).hom x)) :
    ∃ e : (colimit L : CommRingCat.{u}) ≃+* Localization.AtPrime p,
      ∀ i (z : L.obj i), e ((colimit.ι L i).hom z) =
        Localization.localRingHom (pᵢ i) p (κ.app i).hom (hp i) (eᵢ i z)
